data.title: The guide between the books

memoryNodes.cue: Books are grouped by their subjects.

data.situation:
At the library, Lin followed a label from the entrance to a shelf of local history. The books were classified by subject, and a small chart explained the classification system. She found a thin guide between two heavy volumes. Its diagrams made the search easier, even though the shelf numbers were new to her. From the course tutor
Please peruse the attached guide before Friday. During our discussion, we will look at the photographs as well as the written account. A careful perusal of the captions may help you notice which details are missing. Lin: The first instruction is straightforward, but the second one is very long.
Maya: Could we simplify it? It asks you to compare two photographs and give a reason.
Lin: That makes sense. I was trying to answer three different questions.
Maya: Write the main question at the top of your page. Lin copied the shorter instruction into her notebook, then returned the guide to its gap on the shelf. She could now find it again without asking the librarian to walk there with her. The quiet table beside the window was free. She sat down with the two photographs and began.

readingBlocks.en: At the library, Lin followed a label from the entrance to a shelf of local history. The books were classified by subject, and a small chart explained the classification system. She found a thin guide between two heavy volumes. Its diagrams made the search easier, even though the shelf numbers were new to her.
readingBlocks.zh: 在图书馆，林沿入口处的标牌找到地方历史书架。书籍按主题分类，一张小图解释了分类系统。她在两本厚书之间找到一本薄指南。她还不熟悉书架编号，但指南中的图解让查找更容易了。

readingBlocks.en:
From the course tutor
Please peruse the attached guide before Friday. During our discussion, we will look at the photographs as well as the written account. A careful perusal of the captions may help you notice which details are missing.
readingBlocks.zh:
课程导师发来：
请在周五前细读附件中的指南。讨论时，我们既看文字记述，也看照片。仔细阅读图注，或许能帮助你注意到哪些细节缺失了。
readingBlocks.title: A message from the tutor

readingBlocks.en:
Lin: The first instruction is straightforward, but the second one is very long.
Maya: Could we simplify it? It asks you to compare two photographs and give a reason.
Lin: That makes sense. I was trying to answer three different questions.
Maya: Write the main question at the top of your page.
readingBlocks.zh:
林：第一条指令很易懂，但第二条很长。
玛雅：能把它简化吗？它要你比较两张照片，再给出一个理由。
林：这样就说得通了。我之前以为要回答三个不同的问题。
玛雅：把主要问题写在这一页的最上方。

readingBlocks.en: Lin copied the shorter instruction into her notebook, then returned the guide to its gap on the shelf. She could now find it again without asking the librarian to walk there with her. The quiet table beside the window was free. She sat down with the two photographs and began.
readingBlocks.zh: 林把较短的指令抄进笔记本，再把指南放回书架上的空隙。这一次，她不必请图书管理员陪着走，就能再次找到它。窗边那张安静的桌子空着。她带着两张照片坐下，开始工作。

glossary.note: 及物动词classify something by/according to + 标准。
glossary.example: The library classifies books by subject.
glossary.exampleZh: 图书馆按主题给书分类。

externalEvidence.definition: arrange or order by classes or categories

glossary.note: classification system表示按标准给事物分组的体系。
glossary.example: The chart shows the classification of the library’s books.
glossary.exampleZh: 图显示了图书馆书籍的分类。

externalEvidence.definition: the act of distributing things into classes or categories of the same type

glossary.note: 正式用语，本句为认真阅读；日常可说read the guide carefully。
glossary.example: Please peruse the guide before Friday.

externalEvidence.definition: examine or consider with attention and in detail

externalEvidence.label: Oxford · peruse
externalEvidence.findingZh: 细读用法属正式表达；原词义保留，不作为每次口语必用。

glossary.zh: 细读；仔细查看这一行为
glossary.note: 正式名词，a careful perusal of something 表示仔细阅读某份材料。
glossary.example: A careful perusal of the captions may reveal missing details.
glossary.exampleZh: 仔细读图注，或许能发现缺失的细节。

externalEvidence.definition: reading carefully with intent to remember

glossary.zh: 容易理解或操作的；不复杂的
glossary.note: 这里表示不复杂、容易理解，而不是描述坦率的人。
及物动词simplify + 说明、过程等。
glossary.example: Could we simplify the long instruction?
glossary.exampleZh: 可以把这条长指令简化吗？

externalEvidence.definition: make simpler or easier or reduce in complexity or extent

glossary.note: easy的比较级easier；make something easier表示使某事更容易。
glossary.example: The diagrams make the search easier.

externalEvidence.definition: posing no difficulty; requiring little effort

glossary.note: make sense为本身可以理解；与make sense of something努力理解某物区分。
glossary.example: The shorter instruction makes sense to Lin.
glossary.exampleZh: 较短的指令对林来说说得通了。

externalEvidence.definition: be reasonable or logical or comprehensible
